newsitem.title: FINLAND: FOREST INDUSTRY OUTLOOK BRIGHTENING - PM LIPPONEN.
newsitem.headline: FOREST INDUSTRY OUTLOOK BRIGHTENING - PM LIPPONEN.

text.p: The outlook for the forest industry is brightening, Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen said on Monday.
"The prospects for the forest industry are brightening since companies' orderbooks started to grow in the summer," Lipponen said in the text of a prepared speech.

"A favourable trend will, however, require that things are in order not only on the demand side, but on the supply side as well," Lipponen said, adding this meant the forest industry needed a sufficient supply of raw wood "and at a moderate price."
He made no mention of the still partly open regional raw wood price talks between buyers and sellers.
Although the general outlook was now improving, Lipponen said the forest industry had a long way to go before reaching the output volumes and product prices of one year ago.
"Finland must take care of its forestry and forest industry know-how persistently and at all levels," he said.
A new approach was needed in particular in the mechanical forest industry's product development, production methods and marketing, he said, but did not elaborate.
